title: Factory Raises $200 Million at a $5 Billion Valuation
summary: The coding-agent startup is expanding from task automation into a model-flexible software factory spanning enterprise development, testing, security and release.
body:
Factory has raised $200 million at a $5 billion valuation, more than tripling its reported $1.5 billion valuation from an April financing. The round brings the company’s total funding above $400 million and was backed by Blackstone, Khosla Ventures, Sequoia Capital, Insight Partners, Evantic Capital, Sound Ventures, NEA, Mantis VC and Clearlake.

## From coding agent to software factory

Factory’s product is built around “Droids,” software agents that can handle multiple stages of the development lifecycle rather than only generating code. The company says its platform can support triage, planning, implementation, code review, testing, documentation, security checks and release workflows.

A key design choice is model routing. Factory says its system can assign individual tasks to different models, including models from competing vendors, instead of tying customers to one provider. Its April-launched Factory Router reportedly reduced token spending by more than 60% while preserving frontier-level performance, although that figure comes from the company and has not been independently audited.

The platform can run in cloud, self-hosted and air-gapped environments. Factory says customers include Nvidia, Adobe, Palo Alto Networks, T-Mobile, Blackstone and Royal Bank of Canada, and that hundreds of thousands of developers use the product.

## Why the financing matters

The round is less notable as another large AI cheque than as a signal about where enterprise buyers believe coding agents are heading. The pitch is shifting from “an assistant that writes code” to an operational layer that coordinates work across repositories, infrastructure and review systems. That broadens the potential budget, but it also raises the bar: reliability, security controls and measurable business output matter more than impressive code samples.

Factory’s valuation jump also shows how aggressively investors are pricing the software-agent category. The unresolved question is whether self-improvement and multi-agent coordination will produce durable productivity gains, or simply add another management layer around unreliable automation.

## Uncle Cat take

Factory’s real advantage is its model-routing and air-gapped deployment story; the $5 billion valuation still assumes enterprise reliability that has not been publicly demonstrated at scale.
title_zh: Factory 获 2 亿美元融资，估值升至 50 亿美元
summary_zh: 这家编码智能体公司正从单点代码生成扩展到覆盖开发全流程的软件工厂，押注可切换模型的企业级自动化平台。
body_zh:
企业编码智能体公司 Factory 宣布完成 2 亿美元融资，投后估值达到 50 亿美元，较今年 4 月披露的 15 亿美元估值大幅上涨。此轮融资后，Factory 累计融资额超过 4 亿美元，投资方包括黑石、Khosla Ventures、红杉资本、Insight Partners、Evantic Capital、Sound Ventures、NEA、Mantis VC 和 Clearlake。

## 从编码助手走向软件工厂

Factory 的核心产品由名为“Droids”的软件智能体组成，目标不只是生成代码，而是覆盖软件研发的多个环节。公司称，平台可以参与需求分流、规划、实现、代码审查、测试、文档、安全检查和发布流程。

Factory 的一个关键设计是模型路由。平台可以根据任务特点调用不同厂商的模型，而不是把客户锁定在单一模型供应商上。公司表示，4 月推出的 Factory Router 可在保持前沿模型表现的同时，将 token 消耗降低超过 60%；这一数字目前仍主要来自公司自述，尚未有独立审计。

平台支持云端、自托管和隔离网络部署。Factory 称，其客户包括英伟达、Adobe、Palo Alto Networks、T-Mobile、黑石和加拿大皇家银行，全球使用者已达数十万名开发者。

## 为什么这轮融资值得关注

这笔融资的重要性不只在于金额，而在于企业客户对编码智能体形态的预期正在变化。市场叙事已从“帮助开发者写代码的助手”，转向协调代码库、基础设施和审核系统的研发运营层。这意味着可争取的预算更大，但可靠性、安全控制和实际产出也必须经受更严格的检验。

估值在数月内快速攀升，也说明投资者正在激进押注软件智能体赛道。尚未解决的问题是：自我改进和多智能体协作能否带来持续生产率提升，还是只会在不稳定的自动化之上增加新的管理复杂度。

## 猫叔判断

Factory 的真正卖点是模型路由与隔离部署；50 亿美元估值却已提前计入了尚未被公开大规模验证的企业可靠性。
